mission.name: Chaos at the windward mark (7 vessels)
mission.description: Six vessels beat upwind toward the same mark from a narrow, left/astern sector (roughly the same close-hauled heading, only their tack angle/speed differ), each rounding at its own staggered moment and bearing away onto the SAME new heading (south, broad reach) but at a different post-rounding speed -- plus one becalmed/dead-in-the-water vessel sitting at the mark itself. The busiest of the three -- a 6th, wide-out straggler rounds last and long after the others are already reaching away, so the 'clear' water behind the fleet fills in too. Correct: Rule 8 -- a single holistic plan re-checked continuously as each vessel rounds, not a per-contact reaction.
pass_criteria: Own-ship avoids collision with all 7 contacts.

evaluation.verdict: FAIL -- did not reach the goal
